options.label: Four-rung, vanilla
options.tagline: 4 added technologies; everything else is vanilla — eras, names, prerequisites.
options.blurb: Written by tools/make_tier4_techs.mjs from the game files and tools/lib_tier4_spec.mjs.

techs.name: Spray Finishing
techs.desc: Nitrocellulose lacquer laid on with a compressed-air gun dries in minutes rather than days, and a finishing shop stops being the slowest room in the factory.

techs.name: Continuous Web Processing
techs.desc: A paper machine that forms, presses and dries an unbroken web at speed, so the mill’s output stops being a count of sheets and becomes a rate.

techs.name: Catalytic Synthesis
techs.desc: Promoted iron catalysts and continuous high-pressure reformers turn fixed nitrogen from a laboratory triumph into a commodity produced by the shipload.

techs.name: High-Speed Diesel
techs.desc: Small fast-running diesels on welded frames, built by the thousand for lorries, launches and generators rather than one at a time for ships.
